push.title: L 2-3 vs ChicagoOvO | You: 7.9
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.9 against ChicagoOvO. You're on the right road. Let's find the passing lane.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against ChicagoOvO. You found the corner like it owed you rent.
+ 1 key pass. Making chances is a gift, and you were Santa Claus tonight.
+ You and BellyTb1 had more chemistry than a high school lab.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (26 vs their best 21). That's the stuff I want framed.
+ 3 goals conceded gave you a +0.1 lift. Nice little tailwind.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. From the clipboard: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. Habits beat highlights.
- Missed tackles 3, up from your usual 2. A little secret: Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
- Your 4th straight loss. We'll talk about it as a group, then leave it behind us.
- Pass accuracy: 81%. Aim for 88%+.
- A one-goal loss (2-3): a single moment decided it. That's the scoreboard being honest with us.

Pre-match routine: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: A team that laughs together stays together. Tell a bad joke tomorrow.

Keep believing. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-3 vs ChicagoOvO | You: 7.9
push.body:
A 7.9 against ChicagoOvO, BellyTb1. Good bones. Now let's hang some pictures on 'em.

THE GOOD
+ 32 passes (up from your usual 16). You were the hub of the wheel.
+ A goal against ChicagoOvO. You finished it like the last bite of a good steak.
+ 1 assist. You threaded the needle and stitched up a chance.
+ You set it up, PhogsToffees knocked it down. Repeat as needed.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. For next time: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized. Believe.
- No key passes from 32 passes. Here's the trick: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner. Rome, day by day.
- buddskees had the same playing forward gremlin. Squash it together: make the run for each other.
- Your 4th straight loss. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.
- 3 goals conceded cost you 0.1. Next match, keep it simple.

Kickabout task: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

BellyTb1, something I want you to sleep on: Talent wins games; teammates win seasons.

One rough patch doesn't define a field. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-3 vs ChicagoOvO | You: 7.5
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.5 is a quiet night for a midfielder. Quiet nights teach the loudest lessons.

THE GOOD
+ 27 passes (up from your usual 20). You found pockets of space like a cat finds sunbeams.
+ Won 3 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 63%). That's defending a coach can trust.

THE BAD
- 63% passing (17 of 27, down from your usual 74%). Think about this: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- No key passes from 27 passes. Little homework: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from. Fix it and forget it.
- You and BellyTb1 were in the same boat on playing forward. Row together: make the run for each other.
- 0.5 down on your average. Tomorrow's a fresh page.
- In our wins you average 2 goal involvements; here it was 0. Honest truth: that cost us.

Tonight's homework: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.

Before you go, buddskees: The scoreboard counts goals; I count growth.

Keep showing up; the results will too. - Coach Lasso
